column3: “anyone” renders “a soul (nefesh),” and “a grain offering” renders “minhah.”
“its memorial portion” renders “azkarah” (also in verses 9 and 16).
“a thing most holy” renders “a holy of holies.”
“a thing most holy” renders “a holy of holies.”
“early ripened things” renders “first fruits (bikkurim),” “fresh heads of grain” renders “aviv,” young ears, and “grits of new growth” renders “groats of fresh grain (karmel).”
